title: Rankers, Judges, and Assistants: Towards Understanding the Interplay of LLMs in Information Retrieval Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM relevance judges' evaluations of LLM-based ranking systems against 'oracle' rankers (derived from human ground-truth labels) to measure if LLM judges systematically inflate the performance of other LLM-based models.

Comparing the relevance scores assigned by an LLM judge to a balanced sample of original human-written documents versus their AI-rewritten counterparts to detect any inherent preference for AI-generated content.
